title: feat(types)!: retire `WidgetInput.label` / `defaultValue` / `advanced` as ADR-0049 tombstones (objectui#7911)
body:
Fixes #7911

Carries maintainer **ruling A** of 2026-09-15 (objectui#7911 comment 5689209770) to the
second input face: `WidgetInput.label`, `WidgetInput.defaultValue` and
`WidgetInput.advanced` in `packages/types/src/widget.ts` become ADR-0049 retirement
tombstones (`?: never`), and the `widget.ts` divergence doc block is rewritten in the
same stroke to say the two faces now agree. Option **B** (keep and document as inert)
was refused on record; option **C** (a runtime zod mirror for the manifest face) was
offered as a separate card and deliberately not opened.

## Why these three keys are dead

`WidgetRegistry.load()` is the **only** consumer of a widget manifest's `inputs` in this
repository, and it forwards five keys — `name`, `type`, `required`, `options` (renamed to
`enum` at the seam) and `description`. It never forwarded these three. The copy that used
to carry them onto `ComponentInput.label` / `defaultValue` / `advanced` was deleted when
those became tombstones (objectui#7493 / objectui#7781, ruling A of 2026-09-06), and that
copy was the one non-test write of the three. Since then they have been declared and
unread on their own face.

Re-derived on this branch by symbol, each zero paired with a firing control on the same
instrument (the card's own line references were stale — they came from `6a9ee323`):

| reading | value | control on the same instrument |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `input.label` / `.defaultValue` / `.advanced`, non-test `.ts`/`.tsx` | **0 / 0 / 0** | `input.options` 2 · `input.type` 10 · `input.name` 7 · `input.required` 4 · `input.description` 1 |
| structural reads of `manifest.inputs`, tree-scoped | **1** (`WidgetRegistry.ts`) | `manifest.type` fires in the same walk |
| `WidgetInput` in `packages/types/src/zod/` | **0** | `ComponentInput` **22** |
| `WidgetInputSchema` / `RuntimeWidgetManifestSchema`, tree-wide | **0** | `ComponentInputSchema` present in 7 files |
| a minted absent token on the same greps | **0** | — |

`new WidgetRegistry(...)` is constructed nowhere outside `packages/core`'s own tests, and
none of those tests authors an `inputs` array, so no in-repo authoring site breaks.

## ⚠️ The limit of this change — please read this before judging it

**The tombstone has no runtime face, and that is the whole cost of ruling A.**

`WidgetInput` has no zod mirror, so unlike the `ComponentInput` retirement — which pairs
`?: never` with a `retirementTombstone()` parse refusal — this one is a `tsc` error at a
TypeScript authoring site and nothing else. `WidgetRegistry` does no deserialization and
no validation: it reads five keys off whatever object it is handed. So a widget manifest
that arrives as **JSON** is never parsed through this type, and an author outside this
repository who writes `label` gets exactly what they got before — the key is ignored,
**silently**. Making that refusal loud for the authors who actually exist is option C,
which is not in this PR.

**The in-repo zero is the measurable half only.** Widget manifests are authored outside
this repository **by design** (the card says so, and the triage seat and the `domain:spec`
seat both carried it forward). Whether anyone out there writes these keys was never
measured and is not measurable from here. ⛔ A green run of the new pin does **not** mean
nobody writes them; it means nothing in this repository reads them or may author them.
The pin's own header says this so a later reader cannot mistake one for the other.

## The stop condition the ruling named, answered

The ruling made this an explicit precondition: *"The report states whether any runtime
loader reads manifest JSON through this type — if one does, it stops and reports before
changing behaviour."*

**Answer: NO runtime loader in this repository reads manifest JSON through `WidgetInput`.**
Four readings, each with a control:

1. No zod mirror of the face (0, control `ComponentInput` 22) ⇒ no validator derives from it.
2. `WidgetRegistry.ts` contains no `JSON.parse`, no `fetch(`, no `safeParse`, no `zod`
   (`JSON.parse|fetch(` = 0 in `packages/core/src/registry/`, control 21 across
   `packages/core/src`; control `manifests.set` = 1 fires in the file itself).
3. No type-to-runtime-schema codegen is configured anywhere (exit 1, control fires).
4. `@object-ui/types` reaches the seam through `import type`, which is erased at build.

⇒ `?: never` changes the **declared** face only. Runtime acceptance is byte-for-byte what
it was. Readings 1, 2 and 4 are pinned in the new test so this answer can be re-derived
rather than believed.

## What changed

- `packages/types/src/widget.ts` — the three members become `?: never`, each with a named
  migration note (what to write instead: nothing; `description` is the published place to
  tell an author anything about an input). The divergence doc block's item 3 flips from
  "three keys this face DOES declare are tombstones on `ComponentInput`" to "BOTH FACES
  AGREE", and carries the runtime-face limit above so it cannot be re-opened by accident.
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/widget-input-retired-keys-7911.test.ts` — new, 21
  assertions in six directions (below).
- `packages/core/src/registry/WidgetRegistry.ts` — comment only. The seam comment asserted
  "they stay writable there", which this PR makes false.
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/component-input-retired-keys-7493.test.ts` — the new pin is
  added to that census's `SKIPPED` set, with the reason stated inline: it authors
  `defaultValue` inside a `RuntimeWidgetManifest.inputs` literal under `@ts-expect-error`,
  which that walk's `inputs: [` regex cannot tell apart from a component registration. The
  file's header prose was updated in the same stroke so it does not keep claiming a
  two-entry skip list.
- `.changeset/7911-widget-input-retire-label-defaultvalue-advanced.md`.

## Pins, in both directions

1. **Refusal** — authoring each retired key is a `tsc` error, on a bare `WidgetInput` and
   through the `RuntimeWidgetManifest` door.
2. **Control** — the five live keys still author cleanly, and none of them is `never`.
   `RuntimeWidgetManifest.label` (a *different* key, which the loader does read) is
   asserted still live, so the retirement cannot be over-applied.
3. **Tombstone, not deletion** — `?: never` is pinned as source text, with each key's doc
   block required to name the ruling, the ADR, and `@deprecated`.
4. **Why they are dead** — the seam's forwarded key list is read off disk and asserted as
   an **equality**, so a seam that quietly started forwarding a retired key goes red.
5. **The limit** — no zod mirror (control: `ComponentInput` has one), and no parse or
   validation sink in the loader.
6. **The doc block** — asserts the agreement is recorded and the limit stays visible.

## Reverse verification (one-off, not a committed test)

Ran from the committed state; the mutation put the three members back to `label?: string`,
`defaultValue?: unknown`, `advanced?: boolean`, with a `trap ... EXIT INT TERM` restore.

- Landed on disk: tombstone lines `3 → 0`, pre-retirement lines `0 → 3`; blob
  `457b6661` → `9724faa2`.
- Reached the published face: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build` re-emitted
  `dist/widget.d.ts` with `label?: never` occurrences `1 → 0` and `label?: string` `0 → 1`.
- **Predicted direction: RED. Observed: RED, on both legs.**
  - vitest `3 failed | 18 passed` — the three `?: never` source-text pins.
  - `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exit 2 with four `TS2578: Unused '@ts-expect-error'
    directive` — the refusal assertions are real enforcement, not decoration.
- Restored and proved it: blob back to `457b6661` (equal to the `HEAD` blob),
  `git diff HEAD` for the path **empty**, rebuild green, and the file re-runs
  `21 passed` with `tsc` exit 0.

## Gates

⚠️ `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` lives in the sibling `objectstack` checkout and
**refuses cross-repo by design**, so it cannot answer for this repository and `--ran`
reconciliation was **unavailable**. The list below was hand-derived from this repo's own
root `check:*` scripts and `.github/workflows/`. Exit codes captured before any pipe.

| gate | exit |
|:--|:--|
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build` (includes `check-dist-completeness`) | 0 |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` (`tsc` + examples + tests) | 0 |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/core type-check` | 0 |
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/ packages/core/` | 0 — **347 files / 7829 tests passed** |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types lint` · `--filter @object-ui/core lint` | 0 · 0 (warnings pre-existing, 0 errors) |
| `check:control-bytes` | 0 |
| `check:test-path-roots` | 0 |
| `check:new-line-citations` | 0 |
| `check:unreferenced-sources` | 0 |
| `check:comment-mask-corpus` | 0 |
| `check:spec-symbols` | 0 |
| `check:vi-mock-override-shape` | 0 |
| `check:changeset-claims` (report-only) | 0 |
| `check-changeset-presence` · `check-changeset-no-major` · `check-changeset-fixed` | 0 · 0 · 0 |
| `check:readme-exports` | **NOT MEASURED** — see below |

`check:readme-exports` exits 1 in this worktree for a **prerequisite** reason, not a
finding: its four complaints all read *"its type entry `./dist/index.d.ts` is not on disk
— run `pnpm build` first"* and name `plugin-calendar` / `plugin-gantt` / `plugin-kanban`,
packages this diff does not touch; it then reports its own population as COLLAPSED
(`packagesRead: found 2, floor is 25`). 1 of 40 packages is built here. `readme-exports.yml`
runs `turbo run build --filter='./packages/*'` **before** the gate, so CI measures it on a
built tree. This diff changes **zero** README files.

**Declared narrowing of local scope.** The repository-wide runs — `pnpm test`,
`pnpm lint`, `pnpm type-check` over all 40 packages, and the full `turbo` build — are CI's,
not this seat's. The narrowing above is a measurement rather than a gap because the blast
radius was enumerated by symbol: `WidgetInput` and `RuntimeWidgetManifest` are referenced
by exactly two packages, `@object-ui/types` and `@object-ui/core`, and both were built,
type-checked, linted and tested in full here.

## Changeset

`minor` with a **BREAKING** banner, per the gate's verdict rather than the ruling's prose:
`check-changeset-presence` scored the change *"minor at most, never major"* (every package
sits in one fixed group pinned to the `@objectstack` major — AGENTS.md §版本号策略, enforced
by `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`). The banner is earned: the published `.d.ts` member set
moves, confirmed on the built artifact — `packages/types/dist/widget.d.ts` now emits
`label?: never`, `defaultValue?: never`, `advanced?: never` where it emitted `string`,
`unknown` and `boolean`.

Every figure above was taken on `598c45ffb`, the final commit on this branch.
